audit_items.proof_trace: Freshness is enforced at two levels: (1) ingestion in `assert_price_not_stale` (hardcoded 30s window, pyth_adaptor.move:81-89) and (2) consumption in `check_price` (configurable `price_delay_tolerance_ms`, user.move:65-67). Confidence interval is validated at ingestion via `assert_price_conf_within_range` (pyth_adaptor.move:91-96). All protocol price consumers in market.move exclusively import `get_price`/`get_spot_price`/`get_price_with_check` from user_oracle — every path calls `check_price`, so the staleness assertion `price.timestamp >= clock.now - max_staleness` holds on every consumption path.
